name: Tree Craft
request:
Re-create Speedtree modeler for games. 
What I want to see in this first version:
1. The node graph to create trees. This should have options to create trunk, branches and leaves
2. Material editor similar to the one in Speedtree modeler
3. Mesh editor tab similar to the one in Speedtree modeler
4. Viewport: Perspective by default with option to switch to orthographic views
5. Properties panel on the left side. When I click a node in the node graph, its properties should show in this panel
Create these first, then we will go ahead and tweak it
I don't need any tree pre-sets. I only need custom generation tools, no need to have any tree pre-sets
